nwa.review: whatever u do just don't take nwa

Probably one of the best reviews on nwa I have seen, but I should add something. He's not worthy of being called a university teacher. Ami tar kach theke A pawa shotteo ei kotha boltesi. His exams are very straightforward, but he's very inconsiderate when it comes to insignificant things. I still remember ekjon class e early eshe bag rekhe ektu washroom e gesilo. Sir came to the class after him. Washroom theke ferot ashar por the guy was being interrogated as if he committed a crime. Tar bag bhetore chilo and he told him the same thing. Wasn't that enough of a proof that he came in the class within time? 5 min o hoy nai class start hoisilo. There was no need to make a big deal out of this, and this is just one incident, emon kaaj shey aro korse. This isn't school. It's a university. You gotta treat people with respect regardless. The guy (from what he said) has a car tai brishtir dineo shey class e timely ashte pare, but it won't necessarily be the same for the girl who is travelling from puran dhaka. Even after knowing all this, he'll have something to say, regardless of attendance dibe naki na. He has 0 empathy. Amra tar moto faculty der kach theke A/A- pawar por bhule jai what we had to endure under them, and it's reflected on our reviews. Don't assume I am criticizing you. He's a fair grader, and I disagree when someone says he's unfair (he's not). But that doesn't make him a good human being, and definitely not a softie. One guy like him is enough to make your semester bitter. Your experience might have been different, but this was mine.

mbt.review:
The average class time of MBT sir is 45 mins. He takes attendance in the first 5 mins of the class. If you are late he won't consider.
He gives real life examples on the topics. He almost never reads out from the slides.
Ques pattern:
Quiz- MCQs; T/F
Mid and Final - MCQS; T/F; 3/5 Mark questions.
He gradually increases the MCQ difficulty level.
All the ques ans comes from the slides. So you basically have to memorize the slides to score marks in MCQs.
Lab: He taught us to create a grade sheet of a class in Excel.
PowerPoint was in the syllabus but sir was out of country for a month so that was not taught.
Make sure to practice on your own cuz he gives a bonus question in the lab final which really helps to boost your grade.
Project: He asked as to make an app. Not literally but the concept. What social problems the app will solve? The whole project was made on PowerPoint presentation not word document. He gives an detailed document on the project. Just feed it to any AI and ask it to guide you.
Mbt easygoing but average grading dey
